title: Task manager architecture
scope: Design-stage model of a task list manager with reminders, offline sync, notifications and search. Nothing is implemented; contracts point to draft JSON Schemas and example payloads.
limitation: Structural validation only; declarations and file existence do not prove implementation conformance.

unresolved.description: Open: the last write wins, or edits are merged field by field. Merging keeps more work but makes the change-set format and the sync engine more complex.
Open: schedule reminders on the device as well as the server, or accept that an offline phone misses them until it reconnects.
Open: one record whose due time moves forward on completion, or one record per occurrence. This changes the task shape, history and how reminders are scheduled.
Merging may require per-field base versions in each change.
Field-level merging needs per-field versions in the sync engine.
The mobile app may need to schedule local reminders.
Device-side scheduling would split reminder logic across server and phone.
Determines whether rules move a due time forward or create new tasks.
One record or one per occurrence changes the task shape.
